orders.text:
AO No. 86 of 2017
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Ms. Monika Pant, Advocate for 
the appellants. 
Appeal is admitted for hearing. 
Issue notices to all the 
respondents. 
Steps be taken within a week. 
Call the Lower court record. 
List this matter in due course. 
Recovery against the appellants 
shall remain stayed subject to deposit of 
Rs. 8 lakhs of the total awarded 
amount, adjusting compulsory statutory 
amount, within six weeks from today 
before the Tribunal concerned. 
Stay Application (CLMA No. 
1172/2017) stands disposed of. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 16.02.2017
Pooja/A.Kaur

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Rajiv Sharma,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Singh,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
AO 86/2017
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
None for the appellants. 
Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate, for 
the applicants/claimants. 
Rupees four lakhs be released 
in favour of the claimants in 
accordance with their respective 
shares and without asking for any 
surety or security. Rest of the money 
shall be kept invested in TDR with 
some local scheduled bank. 
Money withdrawal application 
(CLMA 4014/2017) stands disposed 
of. 
List in due course. 
 
 
 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 24.4.2017 
Prabodh
